rule.statement: Applying a regulation to a 2008 action that has been in force since 2003 involves no retrospectivity whatsoever.
rule.supporting_quote: As this Court has already observed, applying to a 2008 action a regulation that has been in force since 2003 involves no retrospectivity whatsoever.
rule.statute_citation_verbatim: Rent Act No. 7 of 1972, published in Government Gazette bearing No. 1305/17 dated 09 September 2003, was in operation at the time the action was instituted on 29 February 2008, and that the premises bearing assessment No. 81, Castle Hill Street, Kandy, constituted excepted premises within the meaning of that regulation.
